entities.summary: Clement Pemberton Deykin was a British rugby union player who competed in the 1900 Summer Olympics. He was born in Lapley, Staffordshire, and played for Moseley Wanderers RFC. He was a member of the British rugby union team, which won the silver medal. He died in Victoria, British Columbia, Canada.
